ModMetaData.name: Medieval Fast Burglars
ModMetaData.author: Sarelth
ModMetaData.description:
Adds fast, lightly armed burglar specialists for Medieval Overhaul brigand raids.
This is an XML-only prototype of a stealth theft event: it does not add true stealth or custom steal-and-flee AI, but it adds night-themed raid strategy text, fast burglar pawn kinds, dark custom apparel, Biotech xenotype weighting, and optional xenotype weighting for several fantasy gene mods when active.
Requires: - Medieval Overhaul
